description.summary: You play a whimsical yet vigorous tune that shields your allies.
description.value: You play a whimsical yet vigorous tune that shields your allies. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet that would take more than 75% of their current hit points from a single source of damage (after all other sources of damage reduction and resistances are taken into account) have that damage reduced by an amount equal to your caster level + your charisma modifier. Creatures can only benefit from Sentinel’s Scherzo once per round. This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for November 2020 by MagnusXL.
